# Files of cmd/ that may still name *teamstate.Repo (TestCmdDoesNotNameTheWholeRepo,
# internal/archtest/teamstate_interfaces_test.go).
#
# One line per file: "<file> <count>", the reason written above it. The list
# only shrinks: a new use fails the test, and so does a count that went down (or
# a file with none left) until its line is updated here or removed. Never raise
# a count to make the test pass: take the interface of the sub-domain the
# function needs (teamstate.ClaimReader, ConfigWriter, ...) or compose a few
# next to it.
#
# The commands that build the repository keep the concrete type: they clone,
# pull and hand it to helpers that take interfaces.

# runTeamInit: the shared instance of the team commands (teamRepo, set once in
# PersistentPreRun), the repository the init wizard clones, and the two
# constructors ensureTeamRepo / ensureTeamRepoForProject (the second one wires
# launch.Deps.TeamRepo, which is concrete).
cmd/team.go 4

# actionTeamInit: the repository the TUI init wizard clones.
cmd/tui_team_actions.go 1

# wiring of launch.Deps.TeamRepo (services/launch, concrete *teamstate.Repo).
cmd/launch_deps.go 1

# These feed services/workflow.TeamState.Repo, which works on the drafts, the
# history and the queue of the workflows (no interface of a sub-domain yet).
cmd/workflow_layers.go 1
cmd/workflow_doctor.go 1
cmd/brick_doctor.go 1

# saveBoardColumns takes the whole repository: the file belongs to the lot A12
# (column editor, in progress); narrow it to ConfigReader + ConfigWriter once A12
# is merged and remove this line.
cmd/tui_team_columns.go 1
